text:
alex: Heads-up — since the midnight scheduler rollout we're seeing a steady eviction wave in ap-southeast1. Pods getting preempted, then spilled back across AZs and causing a net increase in cross-az egress and tail latency.

maria: Ugh. Any obvious diffs in the new scheduler profile?

alex: It prioritizes rack-local NVLink-friendly nodes for gpu-packing (to improve inter-gpu comms). But looks like for tiny-gang jobs it forces very strict nodeAffinity which leaves tiny pods pending on source racks and then they get force-evicted to satisfy gang/coalescing.

jun: Can you paste the eviction log snippet?

alex: Sure — truncated:```
I0323 00:12:05.123 eviction_controller.go:210] Evicting pod default/training-worker-7 due to gang-satisfier: require-rack: rack-a1
I0323 00:12:05.124 kubelet.go:98] PodBind failed: no nodes matching affinity, falling back to preempt
I0323 00:12:05.129 scheduler.go:456] Spillback to az-b causing cross-az egress + increased attach/detach
```

elena: We're seeing attach/detach storms too? That's expensive on ap-southeast1 (inter-AZ egress cost). autoscaler-bot reported a bunch of spot preempts and rebinds at 00:12.

autoscaler-bot: Scaling events (apse1): 2026-03-23T00:11:48Z - scaleDown triggered (50 pods); 2026-03-23T00:12:10Z - spot preempt (n1-highgpu-4) x7; 2026-03-23T00:12:30Z - scaleUp triggered (60 pods)

maria: Does the policy prefer rack-local even when that violates AZ-spread affinity? Might be a policy ordering bug.

alex: Exactly. The new predicate ordering checks `rackAffinity` before `topologySpread` and before `taintToleration` gating for warm pools. So pods bound to a small rack get hard-blocked and then evicted by the preemptor.

jun: If we revert the predicate order it should stop the spillback loop. Quick mitigation: relax the `rackAffinity` to soft-preference for jobs < 0.5 GPU. Can we hotpatch?

maria: Also, can we add a temporary rule to prefer AZ-local even when rack-preference exists? It's less optimal for NVLink but better for cost/latency overall.

alex: I drafted a tiny patch:```diff
- predicateOrder: [rackAffinity, gangSatisfier, topologySpread]
+ predicateOrder: [topologySpread, gangSatisfier, rackAffinity]
+ softPreferences: { rackAffinity: weight: 50, sizeLimit: 1 }
```

elena: Rollout plan? We should canary the fix in ap-southeast1c first. Also alert finance/ben about temporary egress impact.

deploy-bot: Deployment triggered by alex: scheduler-config v2.1.7-hotfix -> canary apse1c (1/3), track via release-war-room.

jun: Ops checklist: 1) patch config and canary 2) watch pod pending/evict rates 3) if evictions drop, promote; 4) if still bad, revert to v2.1.6 immediately.

maria: Add a short-lived qps throttle on preemptor while canary runs to reduce oscillation. That buys time.

alex: On it. Applying canary now and adding throttle 0.2 qps to preemptor. Will report back in 5–10m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

elena: Also open a cost incident with billing team — we might need a credit request if cross-AZ egress spikes.

alex: FYI metric links: http://grafana.internal/clusters/apse1/evicts (evict-rate), http://grafana.internal/cost/egress-apse1 (egress $).
